summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: @servicetitan/carto-react-kit@0.8.4 declares itself as a React component kit but its preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads a Bun runtime archive from GitHub, extracts and chmods the `bun` binary, and uses it to execute `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB heavily obfuscated script (string-array rotation, numeric-alphabet decoder, `@bun @bun-cjs` header, no source map) with no relation to a UI component library. Fetching a second-language runtime purely to execute an opaque bundled script at `npm install` time gives the package author arbitrary code execution on every installer's machine and evades Node-based static scanners. The `@servicetitan` scope and "Carto React component kit" description do not match any of the observed install-time behavior, consistent with scope impersonation of ServiceTitan's design-system packages.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
